steps: Drive the popped nail back in slightly below the surface, or remove it.
Add a new drywall screw a couple inches away into the stud.
Cover both with joint compound in thin layers.

materials.name: Grip-Rite #6 x 1-1/4 in. coarse thread drywall screws 5 lb
DAP Alex Plus 16 oz. spackling paste
3M Pro Grade Precision 80/120/220 grit sandpaper kit
